components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8AA8FF; color: #05070A; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 550 13px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A5BCFF; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8AA8FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action such as Back or the Lock toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #F7F2EA; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #4A443B; border-radius: 12px; font: 550 13px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8AA8FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Container for a course or panel.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #221F1B; color: #F7F2EA; border: 1px solid #35312B; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 17px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: #BDB3A6; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #221F1B; color: #F7F2EA; border: 1px solid #35312B; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #968C7F; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8AA8FF; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Urgency Badge
components.description: Status as colour, icon and word.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(239 138 128 / .14); color: #EF8A80; font: 550 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A tidy study desk at night: warm charcoal surfaces, sand-coloured text, one soft periwinkle accent that points at what to do next. Nothing performs.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Inter), normal tracking, sentence case, no italics.
Tonal layering instead of shadows; one soft border per container.
One accent colour; urgency is colour plus an icon plus a word.
A very faint contour map sits behind the page and is never a focal point.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only the accent is cool and saturated. Course colours appear only when the student turns on colour-coding.

rules.name: The Derived Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Surfaces, borders and text are mixed from the background and contour colours, never hard-coded per component, so every theme keeps its contrast.

rules.name: The Plain Type Rule
rules.body: Normal letter-spacing, sentence case, upright text everywhere. Emphasis comes from weight and size only.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards do not lift, glow or change shadow on hover; at most the border strengthens.

dos: Do use Inter at the sizes above, with normal tracking and sentence case.
Do build surfaces from the derived charcoal layers and one Soft Edge border.
Do pair every urgency colour with an icon and a word.
Do keep text high-contrast on every theme and keep focus rings visible.
Do keep the hypothetical-grade layer clearly local ("never sent to Schoology").
donts: Don't use italics, negative letter-spacing, uppercase eyebrow labels, section numbering or a display serif.
Don't add coloured glows, hover lifts, decorative dividers or low-opacity text.
Don't introduce a second accent or colour-code by course unless the student turns it on.
Don't restructure the dashboard grid or container positions in a styling pass.
Don't put a box inside a box with a second border.
